svg.title: JobPilot data model
svg.text: MONGODB ATLAS — one store, every collection
jobId — on matches, resumes and applications
PROFILE — one account, many rows per section
answer_bank has no FK to applications — the extension matches an answer
to a form field by question key at fill time.
query filters on it, so one
index. One store, so a hit
returns the JD text with it
PK _id, an ObjectId · FK foreign key · UK unique index · VEC $vectorSearch index · [] array · {} embedded document
Foreign keys are plain PydanticObjectId fields, never Beanie Links — ai holds no database URI, receives them as JSON over HTTP, and cannot dereference a link.
jobs.requirements is the job's tech stack, multikey-indexed — it backs the listing page's keyword filter, so the search needs no join.
